C0123.title: Huang et al. Exploiting Ad Settlement Loopholes to Defraud Advertising Fees
C0123.summary: Public reports show that Huang and others exploited advertising settlement loopholes and refund timing gaps, using large numbers of fake-name accounts to place ads for free and avoid paying for real ad exposure, thereby defrauding advertising fees. The case reflects the risk that ad placement, refund, and settlement rules can be systematically abused, and it highlights the need for ad platforms to detect abnormal accounts, abnormal refunds, and settlement arbitrage. Related controls should also watch for combinations of bulk account registration, refund frequency, and abnormal ad spend.
